title: Reconcile and verify one consolidated source-authorized DFIR release candidate
goal: Consolidate the already green Wazuh pair navigation from PR #120 with original source-authorized cohort catalog and independently reviewed Case ACL release candidate components, targeting the closest product-runtime parent PR #120; preserve all original SHA and product code without rewrite.
invariants: The new integration branch must preserve exact prior product implementation commits as ancestors, with no code rewrite, force push, or new runtime API.
The proposed merge base is the unchanged GitHub PR #113 head, not main; preserve native review and required checks of every relevant ancestor.
Never equate local synthetic owner snapshot, SHA-256 comparison, correlation leads, or green branch checks with production IAM or signed forensic custody.
security_properties: No change to first-party Case/Timeline/typed-source ACL, principal, tenant/environment isolation, or raw evidence boundaries.
Require every mandatory security and runtime check on the actual new integration HEAD; no lowering of the changed-critical-coverage 90% floor.

migration.rationale: Git-only consolidation of existing commits and engineering recovery metadata; no product runtime, datastore or schema change.

verification: PR #120, #113, #122, #123 and #124 frozen SHAs all remain unchanged.
Only newly introduced engineering-control-plane files differ from original #124 product-runtime tree.
